practice.title: Compare two adjacent specializations and choose your next step
steps: Write down the specializations this roadmap branches into.
For two of them, list 3 real job postings and the skills each one asks for.
Score each against the skills you already have and the gaps you still need.
Pick one and write a 30-day plan with a concrete first deliverable for each week.

projects.goal: Complete Specializations & Next Steps for iOS Developer by producing a one-page decision brief comparing two specializations and verifying that every claim is backed by a real job posting you cited.
requirements: Produce a one-page decision brief comparing two specializations — a real artefact, not a description of one.
Verify it by checking that every claim is backed by a real job posting you cited.
outcomes: A chosen specialization with a defensible reason
A dated 30-day plan you can start this week
extensions: Repeat it for a second target role or company and compare the two results.
